RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 30

An all-male panel is not evidence of discrimination by itself. Panels like that are common, and plenty of them pick women. It matters only as context — it goes to whether the process had any corrective check on unconscious assumptions, not to motive.

Lead with the harder facts: fifteen years versus eight, five as deputy, and a stated criterion ("strong digital media") that may have been weighted after the fact. The unanswered request for written reasons is your strongest point and the one most likely to prompt movement.

So: chase the explanation formally, in writing, with a deadline. Mention panel composition once, factually, as part of the picture. Don't make it your headline — it reads as grievance rather than argument.
